artboards.title: As it stands today — three tabs, nine faults, and the drift counted out of the file
Sell — the whole screen, no scroll (was 1348px)
Sell → Roofing — a category is somewhere you went
Quote — the customer is the title
Customers — sorted by who is overdue their own cadence
Money — four figures on hairlines, not a bank card
Day one — not enough is an answer
A read that failed — the figure says so, and never falls back to zero
Account — where the lifetime figures and the shortcuts went

annotations.text:
WHAT WAS SETTLED, AND WHAT FOLLOWS FROM IT

Three things were decided before anything was drawn, and every screen here follows from them.

1. THREE TABS, NOT FOUR. Home was a health score, nine achievement badges, a streak and a leaderboard -- plus one genuinely good list. computeOpportunities() already ranks an unsent basket, an order paid for and waiting at the shop, and a customer past their own reorder gap; it was buried on a tab under a percentage. That list is now the first 200px of Sell, which is the screen an agent opens first anyway. Home is gone. Sell / Customers / Money.

2. THE SCORE AND THE BADGES ARE CUT. 86% was the mean of a backlog score, a repeat rate and a completion rate -- three unrelated ratios averaged into a number nobody can act on, whose third tick restated the opportunities list two sections below it. The rank survives as ONE LINE on Money, because competition between agents is real and a table of it is not.

3. ONE SHELF ON SELL. Solutions, Order again, Earns you a bonus, Your cluster and Buy more pay less were five horizontal bands saying five versions of "sell this", each hiding most of what it held. They are one "Worth pushing" grid with the reason as a chip on the card, and Solutions and Order again are two chips beside search.

THE ACCENT APPEARS ONCE PER SCREEN. Sell: Continue the unsent quote. Browse: View quote. Quote: Submit order. Customers: Add a customer, in the thumb zone. Money: Claim August's bonus -- and when there is nothing to claim that slab is absent and the screen carries no accent at all, which is correct. Today five to nine oxide elements compete on every screen.

MONEY IS INK, NEVER OXIDE. Every price in the app is currently painted red. A price is a size, not a warning. Crimson is kept for the genuinely bad (a customer 74 days quiet), amber for caution, verdigris for good.

PHONE ONLY, AND ITS OWN DESIGN. 15px body, 14-16px row padding, 44px taps, cards, a 44px navy top bar and a 60px white tab bar. There is no desktop artboard because agents work standing up.

NOT ONE FIGURE HERE IS NEW. agentStanding(), monthEarnings(), orderEarnings(), computeOpportunities(), promotionEarnings() and clusterEligibility() already compute every number on these screens. They were spread across four tabs, ninety cards and five shelves. This puts them where they can be read.

WHAT THIS COSTS THE FILE

agent.html is off the house system in every dimension the ratchet measures, and none of it is measured today -- test/design-system.test.js reads index.html only.

  font sizes      17  ->  7   (six of them half-pixel: 11.5 12.5 13.5 14.5 15.5 16.5)
  font weights     6  ->  4   (650, 750 and 800 are not loaded faces; the browser fakes them)
  typefaces      the OS system stack  ->  Inter + Archivo Black + IBM Plex Mono
  radii           21  ->  4
  box-shadows     19  ->  1   plus 3 gradients
  hex colours     33  ->  23  (13 of them off the palette entirely)

Every value on these artboards is lifted from index.html's own :root. No new colour, no new weight, no new size, no fourteenth button family.

THE DENSITY, MEASURED

  Sell      1348px of scroll  ->  fits one screen, no scroll
  Customers 4 rows in 620px   ->  9 rows in 620px
  Money     a 400px bank card ->  four figures in 148px

IF THIS IS BUILT, the honest next step is to bring agent.html under the ratchet -- add it to design-system.test.js as a second source with its own ceilings, so the same monotonic rule applies here as applies to the console.

THE THREE STATES THAT DECIDE WHETHER THE APP IS TRUSTED

DAY ONE. A new agent currently meets a 0% health ring and nine locked badges. The slab names what is missing and the one move that fixes it, and the empty shelf says WHO would fill it and when -- "The shop has not put a bonus on anything this month" rather than "No bonus opportunities right now", which reads as a broken feature.

A READ THAT FAILED. The app today says "You're offline" for two different problems, and the second one is not offline at all: loadAgentHomeData() sets dataLooksSuspect when a read comes back empty on a session it could not renew. That is a server that did not answer, and telling an agent to check their wifi is the wrong instruction. This banner names which failure it is, when the figures were last true, and what to do.

And the two figures that could not be read say so. They show an em dash and "not read - 42,000 at 6:12am", never a zero: a zero that looks measured cannot be told apart from a real one, and on a money screen that is the most expensive possible lie.

The claim button stays live and says "nothing is sent until you tap" -- nothing in this app sends itself, and a stale screen must not start looking like it already acted.

ACCOUNT. Where the lifetime figures, the settlement terms and the shortcuts went once Home was removed. The terms are a sentence, not a badge reading PREPAY that an agent has to have been told the meaning of. No accent: this is a settings screen, and there is nothing to do next on it.
